scope.summary: Implement pixelate StudioLiveFilter kinds; cell-mosaic kinds reuse the studio-engine tessellation core shared with the vector engine (14.5), not a private per-filter impl (Voronoi + Crystallize differ only in cell-fill rule): Color Halftone (per-channel screens, dot 4-127, per-channel angles), Halftone Screen (dot/line/circular + continuous-tone), Crystallize (polygonal color cells), Facet (block clumping), Fragment (four-offset average), Mezzotint (dot/line/stroke type menu), Mosaic (square blocks), Pointillize (random dots on bg color), Voronoi (cell-mosaic tessellation).
acceptance_criteria: Color Halftone, Halftone Screen, Crystallize, Facet, Fragment, Mezzotint, Mosaic, Pointillize, Voronoi
expected_tests: test: Color Halftone per-channel angles; Crystallize/Voronoi share tessellation core (cell topology identical, fill rule differs); Mosaic block size

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-FX-016] Pixelate effects cluster pixels into cells/dots/blocks. Halftone/screen kinds carry per-channel angle and dot parameters. Cell-mosaic kinds (mosaic, crystallize, Voronoi) share a cell-generation core.

[STU-FX-016a] Cell-mosaic effects reuse the `studio-engine` tessellation core shared with the vector engine (14.5) rather than a private per-filter implementation, so cell generation is consistent and testable in one place; the deduped Voronoi and crystallize kinds differ only in cell-fill rule, not in cell topology. | Studio effect | Targets | GPU | Behavior (normative) | |---|---|---|---| | Color Halftone | R | Opt | Simulates enlarged per-channel halftone screens; dot radius 4-127, per-channel screen angles. | | Halftone Screen | R,V | Opt | Dot / line / circular halftone screening with continuous-tone option. Dedup of the halftone pattern filter and the halftone live filter. | | Crystallize | R | Opt | Clumps pixels into solid-color polygonal cells. | | Facet | R | Opt | Clumps similar-color pixels into blocks for a hand-painted look. | | Fragment | R | Opt | Averages four offset copies of the region's pixels. | | Mezzotint | R | Opt | Random black/white or saturated dot/line/stroke patterns from a type menu. | | Mosaic | R | Opt | Clumps pixels into uniform square color blocks. | | Pointillize | R | Opt | Random pointillist dots with the background color as canvas between dots. | | Voronoi | R | Opt | Voronoi cell-mosaic tessellation. | --- ### 7. Render & Generative-Pattern Family (GPU)

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
